facts.fact: Leah 梦见少年时打工的水族馆里 Miri 在 Open Ocean 缸边握住她的手、把她拉到观看长凳上并吻她锁骨下方
facts.anchor: Miri held my hand by the Open Ocean tank, pulled me down onto a viewing bench and kissed me just beneath my collar.

facts.fact: 三人给手电换电池，并因为储物柜里有食物而进食（明知该吃）
facts.anchor: We changed the batteries in the torches and ate because there was food in the lockers

facts.fact: Jelka 躺在主舱地板上睡去
facts.anchor: Jelka lay down on the floor of the main deck and went to sleep

facts.fact: Matteo 坐在通讯台旁反复按下又松开传发射键，后来又开始吹《Farewell and adieu to you fair Spanish ladies》
facts.anchor: began to whistle Farewell and adieu to you fair Spanish ladies again

facts.fact: Leah 由淋浴旋钮推断：淋浴还能用就说明淡水还在制取，情况尚未真正危急，但仍拖延不去查看
facts.anchor: If the shower still worked, then we still had fresh water.

facts.fact: Leah 十三岁时在父亲旧《纽约客》堆里翻到 1989 年 7 月号、内含写 Sylvia Earle 的《Her Deepness》一文并拿走读
facts.anchor: I was thirteen when I found a copy from July 1989 that contained a profile of Sylvia Earle

facts.fact: Earle 的队伍由四名科学家加一名工程师组成，在水下待了两周，记录海洋植物同时被研究
facts.anchor: In a team consisting of four scientists and one engineer, Earle’s crew spent two weeks underwater

facts.fact: Jelka 问“你闻到了吗”，Matteo 的表情显示他已知答案——那是东西烧焦、肉从骨头上烧起来的味道
facts.anchor: It was the smell of something burning, of meat straight off the bone.

relations.kind: 梦中亲密的爱人（Leah 睡醒前后都想着她）
relations.anchor: kissed me just beneath my collar

relations.kind: 同舱同伴；Jelka 睡在 Leah 腿边
relations.anchor: Propped up beside my legs, Jelka was frowning in her sleep.

relations.kind: 同舱三人组成员；Matteo 名义上是工程师
父亲以潜水年鉴和旧杂志塑造了她的深海知识
首支全女性饱和潜水队的领队，被媒体称为 aquababes
relations.anchor: the first all-female saturation dive team in history
